newsitem.title: USA: EndoSonics says FDA completes plant audit.
newsitem.headline: EndoSonics says FDA completes plant audit.

text.p: EndoSonics Corp on Wednesday said its new manufacturing plant in Rancho Cordova has successfully completed a comprehensive audit by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration.
The company makes its new all-electronics Five-64 imaging catheters at the plant.

"Market acceptance of these new catheters has created a tremendous demand, which we believe we can meet based on our expanded capabilities in this new facility," Chief Executive Officer Reinhard Warnking said in a statement.
"Our progress is going according to plan -- we are now producing catheters at a rate four times that of the fourth quarter of 1996 and the rate continues to increase," he added.
Endosonics shares were up 5/8 at 11-5/8 near the end of trading on Wednesday.
